about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

fields.id: unique channel id: '<state lower>-' then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; stable (record ids and snapshots follow the URL, not the id, but merges and reviews follow the id)
fields.state: two-letter postal code of the jurisdiction (DC included)
fields.operator_id: data/dischargers.json id of the operator, or null for an agency or group channel
fields.agency: the agency or group that runs the channel when it is not an operator in data/dischargers.json, else null
fields.name: public name of the operator or agency
fields.permit: the NPDES / state permit the channel serves (one of the operator's npdes_permits), or null
fields.urls: the URL(s) read, http(s); [] only for a channel that is not monitored (none found, email only)
fields.method: how the URLs are read (enums.method); null only when urls is []
fields.legal_basis: the law or permit clause that makes it a public channel, cited; null only for voluntary
fields.monitored: true when this module fetches it
fields.unmonitored_reason: when monitored is false: why (enums.unmonitored_reason); null when monitored
fields.publishes: what the research saw on it (enums.publishes): a current status, a rainfall likelihood, dated notices, documents, only a link elsewhere, sampling results, nothing
fields.note: research note, internal (not exported); required for none_found and other
fields.checked: date the row was last checked against the source, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.barrier: what keeps the channel's notices off the open web (enums.barrier), from unmonitored_reason, the kind and the note (barrier_for); null for a monitored row or one read through a feed (feed_ingested), and for a row the register does not settle (then barrier_review says why)

optional_fields.authority: who is credited on records from this channel (default: name)
optional_fields.noun: the noun of the health wording (default 'Notification page', 'Voluntary page' for voluntary rows)
optional_fields.link_text: for link_only / likelihood rows: what the page links to ('the shared rainfall site'); the wording is 'Links to <link_text> only'
optional_fields.status_pattern: regular expression that finds the current status on the page; when it stops matching the wording says so
optional_fields.entry: {start, end}: regular expressions that cut this row's entry out of a page several rows share (from the first line matching start to the next line matching end)
optional_fields.ignore_lines: regular expressions of volatile lines (readings, clocks) left out of the text hash
optional_fields.records: false: never make records from this channel (default true)
optional_fields.dated_lines_are_notices: true: any added dated line is a notice (an event table)
optional_fields.default_event_type: event type of a notice whose words name none (common.EVENT_TYPES)
optional_fields.every_hours: fetch at most this often (default: every refresh)
optional_fields.headers: 'browser' to send a browser user agent (hosts that refuse others)
optional_fields.feed_source_id: for feed_ingested: the source id of the feed that reads it
optional_fields.signup_url: where the public signs up for its alerts, when it has a list
optional_fields.seeds: {url: [{path, fetched_at, http_status}]}: earlier copies (research, surveys) taken as the first snapshots, oldest first; path relative to the project root
optional_fields.sources: research or registry ids the row rests on
optional_fields.barrier_review: internal: why an unmonitored row has no barrier yet (listed in docs/reviews/2026-11-03-barriers.md)

rules: channels sorted by (state, id); ids unique
operator_id or agency is given; operator_id exists in data/dischargers.json; a permit given with an operator_id is one of that operator's npdes_permits
monitored rows have urls and a method; unmonitored rows have an unmonitored_reason
basis_kind law or permit has a legal_basis
barrier is null for monitored and feed_ingested rows, follows login, bot_wall and image_only, and is set (or barrier_review given) for every other unmonitored row
regular expressions compile; seeds name the row's urls

layout: one file per state, <st>.json {about, schema_version, state, channels}
